Basic Information

  • Full Programme Name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships 2027/2028
  • Organizer: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (CSC) UK Foreign Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO)
  • Location: United Kingdom (various universities)
  • Study Level: Master's (full-time)
  • Duration: 12 months (typical)
  • Intake: September/October 2027
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Applications Open: 8 September 2026
  • Application Deadline: 20 October 2026 16:00 BST
  • Eligibility: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries

About the Scholarships

The Commonwealth Master's Scholarships provide talented students from eligible developing Commonwealth countries with the opportunity to pursue a fully funded Master's degree in the UK. All fields of study are eligible depending on courses offered by UK universities under the scheme.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Be a citizen of or granted refugee status by an eligible Commonwealth country or be a British Protected Person
  • Permanently reside in an eligible Commonwealth country
  • Hold a first degree of upper second class standard (2:1) or above
  • Unable to afford to study in the UK without this scholarship
  • Fields All subjects eligible

Funding Details

  • Tuition Fees: Full tuition coverage
  • Airfare: Return airfare to/from UK
  • Living Allowance: Monthly stipend for duration of study
  • Additional: Warm clothing allowance thesis grant study travel grant
  • Duration: Full duration of Master's programme

How to Apply

  1. Applications open 8 September 2026
  2. Submit via CSC online application system (cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk)
  3. Complete all sections including supporting documentation
  4. Required transcripts references personal statement
